title: Fungi as an emerging waterborne health concern: impact of treated wastewater discharge versus aerosolization
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,1103-1119
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00020C, Paper
Lama Ramadan, Moustapha Harb
Treated wastewater effluents and bioaerosols of treatment plants impact the waterborne fungal communities of irrigation canals differently depending on seasonally-influenced environmental conditions.
